name: Materials
teaser: Look at one electrode material as a tank and see how its dQ/dV shape turns into the voltage curve.
description: Interactive tool: explore graphite, silicon, LCO, LFP, NCA and NMC as tanks and see how dQ/dV peaks become voltage plateaus.
imageAlt: Tank view of a cathode material with its lithium fill level

name: Cell Reconstruction
teaser: Combine anode and cathode into a full cell and see how voltage limits, NP ratio and lithium inventory shape the OCV.
description: Interactive tool: rebuild a full-cell OCV from two electrode tanks and test voltage limits, NP ratio and lithium inventory.
imageAlt: Anode and cathode tanks of a full cell with the cell voltage between them

name: Blending
teaser: Mix graphite and silicon in one electrode and see how the blended tank and its voltage curve form.
description: Interactive tool: blend graphite and silicon and see how the combined tank, the blend OCV and the material states of lithiation relate.
imageAlt: Tanks of two blended electrode materials

name: Aging
teaser: Shrink a tank or lose lithium and see which reservoir limits capacity and how the voltage curve shifts.
description: Interactive tool: apply loss of anode or cathode material and lithium loss and see how capacity, state of health and OCV change.
imageAlt: Aged electrode tanks compared with their beginning-of-life shape

name: Swelling
teaser: See how electrode breathing, SEI growth and compression change the thickness of a cell stack.
description: Interactive tool: see how state of charge, SEI growth and stack compression change electrode thickness and porosity.
imageAlt: Stacked thickness contributions of a cell over state of charge
